习得华山派剑法绝技，天外飞龙。.en: Horus learned Sky Dragon Sword from Thoth.
习得华山派剑法绝技，天外飞龙。.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯向托特学会了飞龙剑术。

神剑仙缘穆人清。.en: Thoth has made time for Horus between the camp's other demands.
神剑仙缘穆人清。.zh-CN: 托特从营地的事务中腾出时间，准备听听荷鲁斯的见闻。

恍惚中天边似有一剑西来.en: A sword strike in a line. Base cost: 2 Rage; base cooldown: 3 turns.
恍惚中天边似有一剑西来.zh-CN: 直线范围的剑术招式。基础消耗2点怒气，基础冷却3回合。

月圆之夜，紫禁之巅，一剑西来，天外飞仙!.en: A sword strike in a star pattern. Base cost: 4 Rage; base cooldown: 4 turns.
月圆之夜，紫禁之巅，一剑西来，天外飞仙!.zh-CN: 星形范围的剑术招式。基础消耗4点怒气，基础冷却4回合。

混元一气，浑身坚逾精钢.en: A mastery technique with a square pattern. Base cost: 4 Rage; base cooldown: 3 turns.
混元一气，浑身坚逾精钢.zh-CN: 方形范围的专精招式。基础消耗4点怒气，基础冷却3回合。

text.en: Thoth, we settled the dispute over the relief gold at Stonebridge.
text.zh-CN: 托特，我们解决了石桥会馆那批救济黄金的争端。

text.en: Hathor sent word. That was no small piece of work.
text.zh-CN: 哈索尔已经捎来消息。这可不是件轻松的差事。

text.en: We had help. This traveler kept us from becoming part of the problem.
text.zh-CN: 有人帮了我们。多亏这位旅人，我们才没把自己也变成麻烦的一部分。

text.en: I prefer being invited back.
text.zh-CN: 我还是更喜欢，人家下次愿意请我回去。

text.en: And Horus says you can fight.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯还说，你很能打。

text.en: Well enough to know when I'd rather be talking.
text.zh-CN: 至少练到了，知道什么时候宁可动嘴的程度。

text.en: Then here's a Gemshatter Fist Manual. A thank-you for looking after my student.
text.zh-CN: 那就收下这本碎玉拳手册。谢谢你一路照应我的学生。

text.en: A gift that will get me into more fights. Thoughtful.
text.zh-CN: 一份能让我卷进更多战斗的礼物。真周到。

text.en: Thank you, Thoth.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢你，托特。

text.en: The camp has enough arguments without me keeping you. Horus, go and see who needs help.
text.zh-CN: 营地里的争论已经够多，我就不留你们了。荷鲁斯，去看看谁需要帮助。

text.en: I will.
text.zh-CN: 我会的。

text.en: When you've something new to show me, come back.
text.zh-CN: 等有了新的体会，再回来让我看看。

text.en: Then I'll make the next visit worth your time.
text.zh-CN: 那下次回来，我一定让你看得满意。

text.en: Thoth, I'd like another lesson.
text.zh-CN: 托特，我想再请教一课。

text.en: Then show me what the road has taught you.
text.zh-CN: 那就让我看看，旅途教会了你什么。

text.en: With pleasure.
text.zh-CN: 乐意之至。

text.en: Less talking. More footwork.
text.zh-CN: 少说几句，多留心脚步。

text.en: Now do you see it?
text.zh-CN: 现在，看清了吗？

text.en: Stop chasing the flourish. Set the angle, then strike. The opening was there all along.
text.zh-CN: 别再追着花招跑。先找准角度，再出剑。破绽原来一直都在那里。

text.en: Not yet. Take what you've learned back onto the road, then try me again.
text.zh-CN: 还差一点。带着这次的体会继续走走，再回来试试。
